g.text: One event per witness row of an out/status.tsv negativeAdmitted row (a certified treatment or same-case history row that the Lean run gave effect: the treating court had power over the target), dated

text.style: fill: #8a8a8a; font: 6.6px 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: by the treating decision (data/treatments.tsv, data/history.tsv). Supersession by statute is dated by the day the effect starts. Dates on the 1st of a month in court-years with a month-precision

text.style: fill: #8a8a8a; font: 6.6px 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: pattern, and all 1 January dates, are dropped (279 events over all years). Bulk coverage thins after mid-2019.
